purpose: Bound decoder concurrency to prevent competing decode and inference pools
changes: FFmpeg decoder limited to one thread, consistent with live decoder. Original selected frame indices, pixels, model threshold and weights preserved.
conditions: AC power; two Torch/OpenVINO threads; one OpenCV thread; no concurrent test or inference jobs
gate: All three runs p95 below 250ms and all controls correct; every scored window included; exact timing/classification agreement and score error <= 1e-4 versus preceding INT8 run
limits: Standalone known-control screening only; actual application and sustained-stream verification still required. No field approval.
